scope: Eight selected questions, actual unforced offline generation with controlled initial submission; no general accuracy equivalence or serving performance claim.
repeat_policy: If target answer/truncation differences appear, independently repeat the affected mode's backend pair in reversed order. If no target symptom appears, repeat all four cells once in reversed order before claiming non-reproduction under this protocol.
graph_coverage: Requires actual runtime graph evidence; enforce_eager=false alone is insufficient.
stop_conditions: foreign compute workload on either selected GPU
source, helper, fixture or required option mismatch
nonzero exit, missing output or invalid token/history evidence
OOM, illegal memory access or engine death
graph arm actually falls back to eager
quality_flags: Recompute the retained scorer from raw text; strict correct requires parsed gold match, normal stop and answer marker. Retain raw correct and every length/unparsed/missing-marker outcome.
causal_limit: Identical initial submission does not ensure identical later histories/batches. Do not infer adapter or graph root cause from late free-generation differences alone.
source_fix_criterion: A reproducible violated local update, state/index/alignment or graph replay contract is required before changing production code. Numerical choice differences alone do not establish a fix.
